title: Champions League winners with two clubs
brief: Name any player who won the Champions League with two or more different clubs, 1993 to 2026. A player counts for a club if he played at least one game for it, group or league stage onwards, in a season it won the trophy.
period: Champions League seasons 1992/93 to 2025/26; group or league stage onwards (qualifying rounds left out)

notes.Achraf Hakimi: Achraf Hakimi won it with 2 clubs: Real Madrid 2018 and PSG 2025 and 2026.
notes.Antonio Rudiger: Antonio Rudiger won it with 2 clubs: Chelsea 2021 and Real Madrid 2024.
notes.Jose Bosingwa: Jose Bosingwa won it with 2 clubs: Porto 2004 and Chelsea 2012.
notes.Christian Panucci: Christian Panucci won it with 2 clubs: AC Milan 1994 and Real Madrid 1998.
notes.Clarence Seedorf: Clarence Seedorf won it with 3 clubs: Ajax 1995, Real Madrid 1998 and AC Milan 2003 and 2007. He also played 6 games for Real Madrid in 1999/2000 before moving to Inter during that season, which Wikipedia does not count as a win.
notes.Cristiano Ronaldo: Cristiano Ronaldo won it with 2 clubs: Man Utd 2008 and Real Madrid 2014, 2016, 2017 and 2018.
notes.Daniel Sturridge: Daniel Sturridge won it with 2 clubs: Chelsea 2012 and Liverpool 2019.
notes.David Alaba: David Alaba won it with 2 clubs: Bayern Munich 2013 and 2020 and Real Madrid 2022 and 2024.
notes.Deco: Deco won it with 2 clubs: Porto 2004 and Barcelona 2006.
notes.Didier Deschamps: Didier Deschamps won it with 2 clubs: Marseille 1993 and Juventus 1996.
notes.Edwin van der Sar: Edwin van der Sar won it with 2 clubs: Ajax 1995 and Man Utd 2008.
notes.Fernando Redondo: Fernando Redondo won it with 2 clubs: Real Madrid 1998 and 2000 and AC Milan 2003.
notes.Gerard Pique: Gerard Pique won it with 2 clubs: Man Utd 2008 and Barcelona 2009, 2011 and 2015.
notes.Kepa Arrizabalaga: Kepa Arrizabalaga won it with 2 clubs: Chelsea 2021 and Real Madrid 2024.
notes.Lucas Hernandez: Lucas Hernandez won it with 2 clubs: Bayern Munich 2020 and PSG 2025 and 2026.
notes.Marcel Desailly: Marcel Desailly won it with 2 clubs: Marseille 1993 and AC Milan 1994.
notes.Marco Asensio: Marco Asensio won it with 2 clubs: Real Madrid 2017, 2018 and 2022 and PSG 2025.
notes.Mateo Kovacic: Mateo Kovacic won it with 2 clubs: Real Madrid 2016, 2017 and 2018 and Chelsea 2021.
notes.Nicolas Anelka: Nicolas Anelka won it with 2 clubs: Real Madrid 2000 and Chelsea 2012.
notes.Owen Hargreaves: Owen Hargreaves won it with 2 clubs: Bayern Munich 2001 and Man Utd 2008.
notes.Paulo Ferreira: Paulo Ferreira won it with 2 clubs: Porto 2004 and Chelsea 2012.
notes.Paulo Sousa: Paulo Sousa won it with 2 clubs: Juventus 1996 and Dortmund 1997.
notes.Samuel Eto'o: Samuel Eto'o won it with 3 clubs: Real Madrid 2000 (3 games that season), Barcelona 2006 and 2009, and Inter 2010.
notes.Thiago: Thiago won it with 2 clubs: Barcelona 2011 and Bayern Munich 2020.
notes.Thiago Motta: Thiago Motta won it with 2 clubs: Barcelona 2006 and Inter 2010.
notes.Toni Kroos: Toni Kroos won it with 2 clubs: Bayern Munich 2013 and Real Madrid 2016, 2017, 2018, 2022 and 2024.
notes.Xabi Alonso: Xabi Alonso won it with 2 clubs: Liverpool 2005 and Real Madrid 2014.
notes.Xherdan Shaqiri: Xherdan Shaqiri won it with 2 clubs: Bayern Munich 2013 and Liverpool 2019.
notes.Mario Mandzukic: Mandzukic won it only with Bayern Munich (2013); he lost the 2017 final with Juventus.
notes.Zlatan Ibrahimovic: Ibrahimovic never won the Champions League.
notes.Arjen Robben: Robben won it only with Bayern Munich (2013).
notes.Thiago Silva: Thiago Silva won it only with Chelsea (2021); he lost the 2020 final with PSG.
notes.Ricardo Carvalho: Ricardo Carvalho won it only with Porto (2004); he had left Chelsea before 2012.
notes.Carlos Tevez: Tevez won it only with Man Utd (2008).
notes.Mohamed Salah: Salah won it only with Liverpool (2019).
notes.Luka Modric: Modric won it only with Real Madrid.
notes.Didier Drogba: Drogba won it only with Chelsea (2012).
notes.Ousmane Dembele: Dembele won it only with PSG; Barcelona did not win it while he was there.
notes.Paul Pogba: Pogba never won the Champions League.
notes.Fabinho: Fabinho won it only with Liverpool (2019).
notes.Ilkay Gundogan: Gundogan won it only with Man City (2023).
notes.Kingsley Coman: Coman won it only with Bayern Munich (2020).
notes.Ivan Perisic: Perisic won it only with Bayern Munich (2020).
notes.Jose Mourinho: Mourinho won it with Porto and Inter as a manager, not a player.
notes.Carlo Ancelotti: Ancelotti won it as a player only with AC Milan, before 1993.

sources: https://www.transfermarkt.com/fc-liverpool/leistungsdaten/verein/31/plus/1?reldata=CL%262004 (the winning club's Champions League squad stats page for each of the 34 seasons; URLs in cl13_two_club_winners.csv)
Wikipedia player articles, Honours sections (for example https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Clarence_Seedorf)
checks: Every player with at least one Champions League appearance (Transfermarkt's CL competition, which leaves out qualifying) for each of the 34 winners was listed; 28 players appear for two or more different winners. Each one's Wikipedia Honours section lists the Champions League with each of those clubs; all 28 agree. Players in a winning squad who never played a game that season do not count.
